caption: Each layer hides the one below it: the editor asks the codec, the codec asks the driver, the driver talks to the device. The codec layer is where the 2 h raw load of 1,345.0752 GB (1080p30 video plus stereo audio) gets compressed.

spec.aria: A four-layer stack from authoring app at the top, down through codecs and APIs, OS and drivers, to hardware at the bottom; the codec layer is marked as where 2 hours of raw media, 1,345.0752 GB, is compressed.
